caption: The drawing depicts a horizontal rectangular strip centered on a beige background. The strip contains three main sections. The uppermost section features a row of small, evenly spaced white circles set against a gray background. Below this, there is a black band. The central section, which is the largest, has a blue background with a repeating white linear pattern consisting of a series of interconnected loops, forming oval shapes. Inside each oval shape is a solid black, eye-like form. Below the blue section, there is another thin black band, followed by a thin white line at the very bottom of the strip. The lower right corner of the beige background has the text "GEORGE E. ROBIN" handwritten in small capital letters. The rest of the beige background appears plain, with a visible light stain near the lower center.
title: Wall Paper Border
